verdict.rationale: Formant documents automations such as event-triggered commands, webhooks and incident-response workflows, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or rollback of those automations. Exporting device configuration to YAML or saving it as a template covers device config rather than automations, and human approval of ML task recommendations is a different feature, so neither counts here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
